BiblicalUsage: Zeredah is a town in Ephraim, the home of Jeroboam the son of Nebat. In 1 Kings 11:26, an Ephrathite of Zereda. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zeredah matters because a king who split a kingdom came from an ordinary town like it.
